sampling: Uniform without replacement from dataset dialogue population; same sampled dialogues across conditions and metrics
estimator: Horvitz-Thompson paired residual correction using known full paired turn denominator; exact design-unbiased under unequal dialogue lengths
interval: Percentile paired dialogue bootstrap with replacement from sampled dialogues; Spark full population fixed; no finite population correction
adoption: At n=100 every dataset/condition/group/metric must have coverage >=0.90 and reduction in median interval width >=0.20
reaction_decision: ADR-016; use existing Gemini full report decision as original reference; also report recomputed common-support reference if moderation removes turns
